integrity: The package includes exact exhaustive enumeration of line-point incidences over F16, a proof that it detects every geometric crossing, and the all-extension boundary and complement-zeta derivation. The preexisting K3 zeta is reproduced as an input. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The new statement concerns only the reduced union of 60 lines and its complement on the explicit F4 quartic. The surface zeta, Picard rank, Frobenius line pairing, and intersection graph are previously determined inputs, not novel claims. Priority for the exact boundary is provisional.
title: The 510 ordinary crossings and arithmetic complement of the characteristic-two sixty-line quartic
